# Jind UI Kit

Jind UI Kit is a TypeScript React component library with inline styles and design tokens.
It uses a token-based theme system (not Tailwind CSS), Zustand for theme state, and supports
both web (`jind-ui-kit`) and React Native (`jind-ui-kit-native`).

Key features:
- 64+ components, 11 hooks, 4 built-in themes
- Zero-dependency (except optional `motion/react` for the Motion component)
- React 19 patterns (ref-as-prop, no forwardRef)
- Named exports only — no default exports
- Polymorphic `as` prop on key components
- CLI tool (`jind-cli`) for selective component installation

## Install

```bash
npm install jind-ui-kit
```

## Quick Start

```tsx
import { JindProvider, Button, Text } from 'jind-ui-kit';

function App() {
  return (
    <JindProvider>
      <Text variant="body">Hello Jind</Text>
      <Button variant="primary">Click me</Button>
    </JindProvider>
  );
}
```

## Theme

The theme is accessed via `useTheme()` and contains:
- `theme.colors` — color ramps (gray, blue, red, green, amber, teal, purple)
- `theme.semantic` — semantic tokens (text, fill, surface, border, icon)
- `theme.space` — spacing scale
- `theme.radius` — border radius tokens (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, full)
- `theme.shadow` — elevation shadows
- `theme.fontSize`, `theme.fontWeight`, `theme.fontFamily` — typography
- `theme.duration`, `theme.easing` — animation timing

## Components

### Animation

- [Motion](https://jind.dev/docs/motion.md): Animation wrapper using Framer Motion

### Buttons

- [Button](https://jind.dev/docs/button.md): Polymorphic button with variant, size, loading, and icon support
- [ButtonGroup](https://jind.dev/docs/button-group.md): Groups buttons with connected or spaced layout
- [IconButton](https://jind.dev/docs/icon-button.md): Icon-only button with tooltip support
- [TextButton](https://jind.dev/docs/text-button.md): Minimal text-style button for inline actions

### Content

- [Carousel](https://jind.dev/docs/carousel.md): Horizontal content slider with arrows and dots
- [TreeView](https://jind.dev/docs/tree-view.md): Hierarchical tree with expand/collapse and selection

### Data-display

- [Avatar](https://jind.dev/docs/avatar.md): User avatar with image, initials, or icon fallback
- [Badge](https://jind.dev/docs/badge.md): Status badge with color variants
- [Card](https://jind.dev/docs/card.md): Container card with header, body, and footer slots
- [Chip](https://jind.dev/docs/chip.md): Compact element for tags, filters, or selections
- [DataTable](https://jind.dev/docs/data-table.md): Enhanced table with sorting, filtering, and pagination
- [Kbd](https://jind.dev/docs/kbd.md): Keyboard shortcut display badge
- [ProgressStat](https://jind.dev/docs/progress-stat.md): Progress bar with label and percentage
- [Skeleton](https://jind.dev/docs/skeleton.md): Loading placeholder with pulse animation
- [StatusDot](https://jind.dev/docs/status-dot.md): Small colored dot for status indication
- [Table](https://jind.dev/docs/table.md): Data table with sorting and row selection

### Feedback

- [Alert](https://jind.dev/docs/alert.md): Inline notification block with tone variants and dismiss
- [EmptyState](https://jind.dev/docs/empty-state.md): Placeholder for empty content areas
- [Spinner](https://jind.dev/docs/spinner.md): Loading spinner with size variants

### Forms

- [Checkbox](https://jind.dev/docs/checkbox.md): Checkbox with label and indeterminate state
- [Combobox](https://jind.dev/docs/combobox.md): Searchable select with autocomplete and keyboard nav
- [DateInput](https://jind.dev/docs/date-input.md): Date picker with calendar dropdown
- [Field](https://jind.dev/docs/field.md): Form field wrapper with label and validation
- [FileUploader](https://jind.dev/docs/file-uploader.md): Drag-and-drop file upload zone with progress
- [Input](https://jind.dev/docs/input.md): Text input field with label, error, and helper text
- [InputGroup](https://jind.dev/docs/input-group.md): Input with prefix/suffix addons and inline elements
- [InputOTP](https://jind.dev/docs/input-otp.md): One-time password input with individual cells
- [NativeSelect](https://jind.dev/docs/native-select.md): Browser-native select with custom styling
- [Radio](https://jind.dev/docs/radio.md): Radio button group for single selection
- [SearchInput](https://jind.dev/docs/search-input.md): Search input with icon and clear button
- [Select](https://jind.dev/docs/select.md): Dropdown select with custom styling
- [Slider](https://jind.dev/docs/slider.md): Range slider with label and value display
- [Switch](https://jind.dev/docs/switch.md): Toggle switch for boolean values
- [TagsInput](https://jind.dev/docs/tags-input.md): Multi-value tag input with keyboard support
- [Textarea](https://jind.dev/docs/textarea.md): Multi-line text input with auto-resize

### Interaction

- [DayToggle](https://jind.dev/docs/day-toggle.md): Day-of-week toggle selector
- [InteractionGroup](https://jind.dev/docs/interaction-group.md): Groups children to share interaction state

### Layout

- [Collapsible](https://jind.dev/docs/collapsible.md): Expand/collapse container primitive with animation
- [Resizable](https://jind.dev/docs/resizable.md): Resizable split pane panels with drag handle
- [ScrollArea](https://jind.dev/docs/scroll-area.md): Custom styled scrollbar wrapper

### Navigation

- [Accordion](https://jind.dev/docs/accordion.md): Expandable/collapsible content sections
- [Breadcrumbs](https://jind.dev/docs/breadcrumbs.md): Navigation breadcrumb trail
- [NavigationMenu](https://jind.dev/docs/navigation-menu.md): Horizontal nav bar with dropdown submenus
- [Pagination](https://jind.dev/docs/pagination.md): Page navigation with numbered pages
- [Sidebar](https://jind.dev/docs/sidebar.md): App layout sidebar with sections and collapse
- [Stepper](https://jind.dev/docs/stepper.md): Multi-step progress indicator
- [Tabs](https://jind.dev/docs/tabs.md): Tabbed navigation with panel content

### Overlay

- [AlertDialog](https://jind.dev/docs/alert-dialog.md): Confirmation dialog with cancel and confirm actions
- [Banner](https://jind.dev/docs/banner.md): Full-width notification banner with variants
- [CommandMenu](https://jind.dev/docs/command-menu.md): Command palette (Cmd+K) with search and keyboard nav
- [ContextMenu](https://jind.dev/docs/context-menu.md): Right-click context menu with Portal rendering
- [Drawer](https://jind.dev/docs/drawer.md): Slide-out panel from screen edge
- [HoverCard](https://jind.dev/docs/hover-card.md): Rich content card appearing on hover
- [Menu](https://jind.dev/docs/menu.md): Dropdown menu with items and dividers
- [Modal](https://jind.dev/docs/modal.md): Dialog overlay with focus trap and backdrop
- [Popover](https://jind.dev/docs/popover.md): Floating content panel triggered by click
- [Toast](https://jind.dev/docs/toast.md): Temporary notification messages
- [Tooltip](https://jind.dev/docs/tooltip.md): Floating tooltip on hover or focus

### Utility

- [Calendar](https://jind.dev/docs/calendar.md): Calendar grid for date picking
- [Icon](https://jind.dev/docs/icon.md): SVG icon renderer
- [MenuItem](https://jind.dev/docs/menu-item.md): Individual menu item component
- [Toolbar](https://jind.dev/docs/toolbar.md): Horizontal toolbar container
- [ToolbarButton](https://jind.dev/docs/toolbar-button.md): Button styled for toolbar use

## Theming

- Themes are JS objects, not CSS variables
- Switch themes at runtime: `useThemeStore().setTheme('neon')`
- Access tokens: `const theme = useTheme()`
- Sub-theme nesting: `<ThemeOverride overrides={{...}}>`
- Color ramps: gray, blue, red, green, amber, teal, purple
- Sparse ramps: blue has 50, 100, 200, 500, 600, 700 (no 300/400)
- Use `theme.colors` (not `theme.color`)

## Important Patterns

- All styles are inline (no CSS classes, no Tailwind)
- Hover/active states use `useState` + mouse event handlers
- Components accept `style` prop for overrides via `mergeStyles()`
- No `forwardRef` — use `ref` as a regular prop (React 19)
- Named exports only: `export function Button`, never `export default`
